exposure: Intracavernous injections of human bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hBMSCs) at doses of 2x10^5, 1x10^6, and 2x10^6 hBMSCs
cohort: A total of 88 Crl:CD(SD) male and female rats, equally divided into 4 groups.
finding: The non-toxic amount of hBMSCs for male fertility and early embryogenesis in rats was determined to be 2x10^6 cells/head, despite dose-dependent increases in penile injection site severity and minimal mononuclear cell infiltration in the epididymis at moderate and high doses.
